description: Carbon Aware SDK is the Green Software Foundation's toolset for choosing when and where computing workloads run using electricity-emission information. It provides equivalent Web API and command-line interfaces and converts provider values to a common gCO2/kWh basis. Inputs specify locations, time windows and a configured data provider; outputs supply emissions information for scheduling and hypothetical workload comparisons. Spatial coverage and temporal resolution depend on the selected provider. Source is free under MIT, while services such as WattTime or Electricity Maps have their own access terms. A limitation is that provider aggregation is described as planned, and the API does not supply generation-mix percentages. The SDK can supply carbon-intensity assumptions to data-centre scheduling simulations. Vessim (platform-vessim) provides related computing-energy simulation. Public documentation establishes the interfaces, but no external data account or deployed service was tested.
name: Carbon Aware SDK
